Welcome to Make Slime!
Cheating/Exploiting is NOT allowed [Punishments are final]

How to play:
🛒 Buy Ingredients
🥣 Mix them in your Bowl
🟢 Make a Slime
💵 Your slimes make Money every second
📖 Discover new Recipes: every recipe gives +5% Money forever

✨ Find rare Golden, Diamond and Galaxy slimes!

🧪 9 ingredients... how many recipes can you find?
